environment.machine: Apple silicon Mac, quiet local machine
environment.php: 8.5.4 (bench recording; the core and bundle suites also pass on 8.2.33)
environment.note: The record is regenerated by hand on a clean local machine with the --baseline-out flag of each timing tool; concurrent modes record the conservative of two consecutive runs. The budgets section byte fields were re-recorded on 2026-09-04 after the P1-8 driver split (the eager core at 103,732 raw / 30,326 gzip / 25,564 brotli under the new 30,720/28,000 compressed caps, plus the three new lazy widget-module rows); the recorded raw_bytes are verified byte-for-byte by perf-budget.sh. The challenge_response_json_v4 budget section was recorded on 2026-09-02 against the php-core armed issuance.

widget_driver.note: The eager driver core (widget-driver.js), three byte-identical copies at 103,732 bytes raw / 30,326 gzip / 25,564 brotli (measured 2026-09-04 after the P1-8 driver split). The raw 160,000-byte cap is carried forward onto the always-loaded core; the compressed caps are the ordinary-bootstrap target of 30,720 gzip / 28,000 brotli bytes. The lazy widget modules (widget-risk.js / widget-telemetry.js / widget-compat.js) and the execution interpreter carry their own budget rows; perf-budget.sh verifies the recorded raw_bytes equals the current measured bytes.

widget_worker.note: The worker asset (kiwi-worker.js), three byte-identical copies at 23547 bytes; the rsw sequential time-lock solver lives inside it (pure JS BigInt, exactly the Argon worker's loading and message pattern); perf-budget.sh verifies the recorded raw_bytes equals the current measured bytes.

widget_runtime.note: The wasm glue runtime asset (kiwicaptcha-wasm.js), three byte-identical copies at 96528 bytes; the embedded worker source is regenerated from assets/kiwi-worker.js by the embed-worker tool, so the rsw solver rides the glue copy too; perf-budget.sh verifies the recorded raw_bytes equals the current measured bytes.

widget_css.note: The widget stylesheet (widget.css), three byte-identical copies at 13863 bytes; perf-budget.sh verifies the recorded raw_bytes equals the current measured bytes.

widget_execution.note: Execution interpreter: raw 33,259 / gzip 10,343 / brotli 8,913 bytes (measured 2026-09-03 after the execution-version-4 nested-tree grammar); hard caps 36,000 / 11,200 / 9,500 with the doc-integrity guard syncing the narrative record.

challenge_response_json.note: The wire shape of the bundle /challenge response, decoy armed; the grammar-composed name length varies the size between runs.

challenge_response_json_v4.note: The wire shape of the bundle /challenge response when the execution dimension is armed (protocol v4; the authenticated decoy rides along, the full decoy-capable canonical), recorded on 2026-09-02; the program op count and the grammar-composed decoy name vary the size between runs.

widget_risk.note: The lazy adaptive-risk module (widget-risk.js), three byte-identical copies at 47,649 bytes raw / 14,347 gzip / 12,228 brotli (measured 2026-09-04). Loaded by the eager core only when a memory-hard challenge, an armed response or the risk-context opt-in needs it: the argon2id/rsw worker solve tier, the ExecutionChallengeV1 runner, the decoy/honeypot rendering and the coarse client-context descriptor.

widget_telemetry.note: The lazy telemetry module (widget-telemetry.js), three byte-identical copies at 2,922 bytes raw / 1,249 gzip / 992 brotli (measured 2026-09-04). Loaded only when a widget enables a telemetry session.

widget_compat.note: The incumbent compatibility-loader module (widget-compat.js), three byte-identical copies at 25,460 bytes raw / 8,160 gzip / 6,969 brotli (measured 2026-09-04). Delivered inside the /api.js loader response (glue + driver core + risk module + compat module) and never fetched elsewhere.
